subject: Discovery follow-up: coordinate technical deep dive & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Becker <tom@medstream.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: coordinate technical deep dive & evaluation plan

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we can lock the right resources: 

High-level recap:
- Current priority: automate clinician note summarization and surface high-confidence suggested edits in the EHR.
- Success criteria you called out: >90% precision on action items in sample prompt set, <150ms median token latency for 512-token responses in production, and clear audit logs for model inputs.

Recommended next steps (so we can scope the evaluation):
1) Technical deep dive (60 min) — architecture, latency profile, data ingestion (S3/DirectConnect), and integration points.
2) Evaluation kickoff (90 min) — trial plan, test prompt set handoff, pass/fail criteria, and run cadence.
3) Security & procurement touchpoint — SOC2 evidence, data residency options, and contract timing.

Candidate times for the technical deep dive (all PT):
- Wed Jan 20, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Jan 21, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Jan 22, 09:00–10:00

I've attached a short starter prompt pack (MVP_prompt_list.xlsx) to illustrate the kinds of prompts we'd test in the evaluation. If you can confirm a preferred slot and who from your side should join (security, infra, procurement), I'll book the calendar and loop in our engineers.

Also: if you have an RFP or procurement doc, please attach it.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

—
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MVP_prompt_list.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 KB)

From: Tom Becker <tom@medstream.com>

Cc: Lydia Park <lydia@caremetrics.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 12:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: coordinate technical deep dive & evaluation plan

Chloe — thanks for the clear recap. Good summary and yes, the three success metrics are exactly what we need to validate. 

We can do Thu Jan 21, 14:00–15:00 PT — that slot works best for our engineering lead (Lydia Park, cc'd) and our security lead (I'll loop them in once we lock).

I attached our procurement RFP (MedStream_RFP.pdf) — it includes the typical questions on data residency, encryption, and contract language. For the security touchpoint, please send SOC2 / audit evidence and a brief note on data at rest encryption and key management (KMS/HSM).

Also, can you confirm who will present the latency/throughput tests during the deep dive? We want someone from your runtime team.

—
Tom Becker
